name: José Javier Rodríguez
summary: José Javier Rodríguez (born August 8, 1978) is an American politician and attorney who served the as assistant secretary of labor for employment and training under President Joe Biden from 2024 to 2025. A member of the Democratic Party, he served as a member of the Florida Senate from 2016 to 2020 and as a member of the Florida House of Representatives from 2012 to 2016.
